items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical vulnerability, which is actively being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento allows an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction. This flaw has been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog due to evidence of active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.
